note: Stanislaus NF campground (signed West Shore) on the north shore of Lake Alpine off Hwy 4, three miles east of Bear Valley, a short walk from the boat launch and Lake Alpine Lodge, which has showers and a laundromat. The concessionaire warns the loop is old, with narrow roads, tight turns, boulders and trees, and paved driveways that may not be level. Cash only on site. --Claude
